purpose: Early performance/representation decision, not full Gate 6 physical qualification
baseline: unchanged v14 code and saved states
planned_measurements: warm captured checked bulk steps, initial/partial geometric cuts
kernel categories diagnostic separately from captured wall throughput
one existing activation with accepted versus discarded bisection propagation
batch scaling smoke 1/4/8 only if independent, GPU memory permits and needed for decision
optimistic ceilings deleting overhead or dominant kernel; explicitly not measured optimized throughput
optimization_policy: At most one equivalent implementation optimization if it could materially affect the feasibility decision; skip if even optimistic ceilings remain orders below target. No new engine or approximation without revised scope.
stop: Stop after measured evidence determines feasibility; no contact/tomato/training run.
